example.problem: Right triangle, angle 46.85, adjacent side 16, find the opposite side.
work: Angle is 46.85, adjacent is 16, opposite is AC.

probe.problem: Right triangle, angle 30, hypotenuse 10, find the opposite side.

learner_message: You used the wrong trigonometric ratio. Look at which side is opposite the angle and which is adjacent — that decides between sin, cos, and tan.
